_comment: Ported from app/data/player_actions.yml. cooldown and castTime are in simulation seconds. Requirement: check = inventory | placed, filtered by item or category, condition = gt | gte | lt | lte | eq. 'craft' is enabled when any recipe is affordable and 'sort_inventory' when the inventory is unsorted (special-cased in code, like PlayerAction#update_disabled). revealRequirements unlock an action for good once met (tech tree); requirements are checked every time.

actions.name: inject
actions.label: Inject Matter
actions.tooltip: Channel elementary matter through the event horizon into the pocket universe. Yields carbon or iron.

actions.name: craft
actions.label: Craft
actions.tooltip: Craft items from your gathered materials.

actions.name: use
actions.label: Use
actions.tooltip: Use the selected item. Select a loot box in your inventory first, then Use to open it.

actions.name: deploy
actions.label: Deploy
actions.tooltip: Deploy the selected item into the selected grid cell.

actions.name: recall
actions.label: Recall
actions.tooltip: Recall a deployed entity from the selected grid cell back into your inventory.

actions.name: load
actions.label: Load
actions.tooltip: Load the selected loot box or radiation source into the irradiation enclosure in the selected cell.

actions.name: unload
actions.label: Unload
actions.tooltip: Take the loot box and source out of the irradiation enclosure in the selected cell.

actions.name: sort_inventory
actions.label: Sort
actions.tooltip: Automatically sort and consolidate your inventory slots.

actions.name: annihilate
actions.label: Annihilate
actions.tooltip: Annihilate the whole stack in the selected inventory slot. It is gone for good.
